test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 29 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Anita bought a square plot to build a house for his family. Each dimension of the plot is in whole numbers of yards. Which of the following can be an area (in square yards) of the plot?
solution:
**Given:**

Area of the plot in square yards = 861

Area of the plot in square yards = 841

Area of the plot in square yards = 881

Area of the plot in square yards = 891

**Formula Used:**

Square plot area = side × side

For a perfect square, area = n², where n is a whole number.

**Calculation:**

⇒ 861: √861 ≈ 29.35 (Not a whole number)

⇒ 841: √841 = 29 (Whole number)

⇒ 881: √881 ≈ 29.68 (Not a whole number)

⇒ 891: √891 ≈ 29.87 (Not a whole number)

**∴ The correct answer is 841.**
